title: PeopleSoft Studio's Event Mapping writer replays App Designer's captured saves: every replay test passes
statement: src/test/eventMappingWriter.test.ts rebuilds App Designer's captured saves (HRDMO, PeopleTools 8.62.09) through Studio's Event Mapping writer and requires App Designer's rows and counters; every top-level test passed in the recorded run. Evidence about Studio, not PeopleSoft (rule 3); it says nothing about releases not captured. docs/CUSTOMIZATION.md lists the cases.

observations.observation: Run of src/test/eventMappingWriter.test.ts (node:test, TAP): 12 top-level tests, all passed.

testResults.name: the key hash is PIA's: SHA-1 over UTF-16LE "( NAME = value )" sorted by name [em01, em03, em04]
a new row on a saved configuration: every row re-saved at the next SCNFM, the parameter its own mapping [em04]
page and record rows added, one disabled, a sequence changed [em05]
a row deleted: the others re-saved first, then its tombstone at the next SCNFM [em06]
Remove: every row with its tombstone, then the content reference's at the next RCSCM [em07]
a content reference configured for the first time: PSPTCS_SRVCFG as the page adds it [em03]
what the page refuses, and what it would not let change
a saved row's level and service are locked; an unknown instance is refused
instance IDs as the page draws them; the token moves with every save
a service defined as the Define Related Content Service page saves it [em01]
